role: Project-agnostic marketing generation OS; brand context loaded per-project via each project's Soul.md.

cold_load.claim: 13 engine entry points resolve from the manifest Engine Master File Mapping (extractor, main-pipeline, vsl, behavioral-intelligence, page-builder, upsell, checkout, email, ads, advertorial, organic).

Cold-load read order: this surface, then AGENT.md (routing/structure/pipeline flow), then ~system/PROTOCOL-MANIFEST.md (loading rules + engine master map), then the active run bundle NEXT_SESSION.json.

verification.name: check-protocol-manifest.py --strict
verification.notes: manifest path-token + profile-ref integrity; exit code is the baseline, not a gate.

do_not_read.entry: **/_deprecated/ -- name rule: deprecated subtrees, not execution entrypoints
MASTER-PLAN.md -- staleness rule: last updated older than 30d vs origin/main
runs/ -- bulk: at/above the pinned 50MB do-not-read cutoff (per-run trace; regenerate, do not read)
~outputs/ -- gitignore rule: project runtime, absent on disk

pitfalls.entry: The environment id is marketing-os-main (matching the GitHub repo) but repo_path is the canonical checkout /Users/anthonyflores/code/marketing-os -- ~/code/marketing-os-main is a symlink to the marketing-os-read-main worktree and is NOT canonical; never point this config back at it.
Root NEXT_SESSION.json has historically been invalid JSON (Codex appended objects without array brackets); the M1 E-adapter salvages it, and a separate writer fix stops the append.
Never edit marketing-os on main directly; every scope gets its own branch plus a peer worktree.
Commits into pg-main-tflo / PG-MUSCLE paths block em-dashes; ASCII hyphen only.
